neutral.EN: Jesus... he's dead.
neutral.TL: Diyos ko... patay na siya.

neutral.EN: I... I really killed him.
neutral.TL: Ako... napatay ko talaga siya.

neutral.EN: God... look at him lying there.
neutral.TL: Diyos ko... tingnan mo siyang nakahandusay.

neutral.EN: He stopped moving... he's really gone.
neutral.TL: Tumigil na siya sa paggalaw... wala na talaga.

neutral.EN: I had to do it... he was shooting at us.
neutral.TL: Kinailangan kong gawin... binaril niya tayo eh.

neutral.EN: Lord help us... what have we done?
neutral.TL: Panginoon tulungan mo kami... ano'ng nagawa natin?

neutral.EN: He's dead. I can't look at it.
neutral.TL: Patay na siya. Hindi ko kayang tingnan.

neutral.EN: His eyes are still open... Jesus.
neutral.TL: Bukas pa ang mga mata niya... Diyos ko.

neutral.EN: I didn't want this... but he wouldn't stop.
neutral.TL: Ayoko nito... pero ayaw niyang tumigil.

neutral.EN: God forgive me. He's dead.
neutral.TL: Patawarin ako ng Diyos. Patay na siya.

neutral.EN: God. That was a person.
neutral.TL: Diyos ko. Tao 'yon.

neutral.EN: A real person... not a zombie.
neutral.TL: Tunay na tao... hindi zombie.

neutral.EN: He had a name... someone knew him.
neutral.TL: May pangalan 'yon... may nakakakilala sa kanya.

neutral.EN: We're killing each other now... God.
neutral.TL: Pumapatay na tayo ng kapwa... Diyos ko.

neutral.EN: He was just trying to survive too...
neutral.TL: Gusto lang din niyang mabuhay...

neutral.EN: That was an actual human being lying there.
neutral.TL: Tunay na tao ang nakahandusay diyan.

neutral.EN: I can't shake this feeling... we took a life.
neutral.TL: Hindi maalis sa isip ko... pumatay tayo ng tao.

neutral.EN: He had boots, a jacket, a life... now he's gone.
neutral.TL: May gamit siya, may buhay... ngayon wala na.

neutral.EN: Killing people... what are we becoming?
neutral.TL: Pumapatay ng kapwa... ano na nagiging tayo?

neutral.EN: That was somebody's family once.
neutral.TL: Pamilya rin siya ng iba noon.

neutral.EN: He's down... let's just get out of here.
neutral.TL: Bagsak na siya... umalis na tayo rito.

neutral.EN: Please... can we just leave this place?
neutral.TL: Pakiusap... pwede bang lumayo na tayo rito?

neutral.EN: Don't search him. Let's just go.
neutral.TL: Huwag mo na siyang kapkapan. Umalis na lang tayo.

neutral.EN: I don't want to be here anymore.
neutral.TL: Ayoko nang manatili rito.

neutral.EN: He's dead. We need to leave before others show up.
neutral.TL: Patay na siya. Kailangan nating umalis bago may dumating pang iba.

neutral.EN: Let's grab what we need and run.
neutral.TL: Kuhanin ang kailangan at tumakbo na tayo.

neutral.EN: I can't stay near his body. Come on.
neutral.TL: Hindi ko kayang tumayo malapit sa bangkay niya. Halika na.

neutral.EN: He's dead... let's just move away.
neutral.TL: Patay na siya... lumayo na tayo.

neutral.EN: Get me out of here. Please.
neutral.TL: Ilayo mo ako rito. Pakiusap.

neutral.EN: It's done. Don't look back. Walk.
neutral.TL: Tapos na. Huwag kang lilingon. Lakad.
